scope.status: confirmed central proof failure with all-hypotheses analytic construction
scope.result: Split paths fix numerator primes in P2 and denominator primes in P1. For g=1 and the explicitly separated prime intervals, a 500R grid meets every stated configuration property but every split edge increases x by at least 3/2, so no path of length >=8 exists. The required k0+2 exceeds7. Directed reading defeats Lemma 3.9; undirected reading does not justify Lemma 5.4's first counting step.

Physical product control, displacement, corrected pyramid telescoping and factorial prime-product counting were checked for existing paths. Original cited separation resolves an apparent ambiguity in intermediate-vertex uniqueness; no independent defect is charged. Corollary 5.3's use of fixed prime roles explains why allowing arbitrary edge reversals is not a complete repair.

The log-loss scale O((logX/logH)loglogX) matches the stated lower H threshold after constants are chosen. Prime disjointness gives a nonzero product difference; small denominator, Ty bound, large common modulus and phase/interval shortening were checked. These estimates do not supply the absent directed paths. Missing modulus bars in the final correlation displays are recorded as a presentation note.
